hero.lead: Askboard answers business questions from your data, and shows how it got there.
hero.aria: Example: a question is asked, the data is prepared, a misleading comparison is caught and the honest answer is shown.
hero.question: Revenue by state, August vs July?
hero.caught_text: August stops on the 23rd. Compared with a full July, the drop is not real.
hero.answer_text: Revenue grew. Askboard proposed the fix, you approved it.

how.title: From a CSV to an answer you can defend
how.text: Six agents do the work an analyst would do. You only bring the file and the question.

drop.title: Drop a file
drop.text: A CSV export from any tool. Personal data is masked first.

prepare.title: Data gets ready
prepare.text: Profiled, cleaned and modelled with versioned rules.

ask.title: Ask in plain words
ask.text: “Revenue by region, March vs February?” in English or French.

check.title: Comparisons checked
check.text: Incomplete or unequal periods are caught before you see a chart.

explain.title: Get the why
explain.text: Every figure has its sources. Ask “why?” at any time.

proof.title: Every answer comes with its proof
proof.text: A dashboard only helps if you can believe it.

explain.title: Anomalies in plain words
explain.sentence: Flagged because the payment value, 2,647.76 BRL, is far above the typical 100 BRL.

journal.title: A journal nobody can rewrite
journal.text: Each decision keeps the fingerprint of the one before. Change a line and the chain breaks.

rows.r1: Missing weights filled with the median

upload.name: Intake
upload.file: {name}: {rows} rows, {cols} columns profiled in your browser.
upload.what: Receives the files and the question, and starts the run.

similarity.name: Similarity detection
similarity.out: No similar dataset found: a new pipeline is built.
similarity.what: Is this data like a dataset already seen? If so, its cleaning playbook is reused.

column_types.name: Column semantic types
column_types.out: Columns classified: IDs, amounts, dates, places.
column_types.what: Gives every column a business type (ID, amount, date, place…) and flags the ones that may be personal.

pii.name: Personal data masking
pii.out: Customer identifiers pseudonymized before any analysis.
pii.what: Decides, column by column, what to keep, pseudonymize or generalize before anyone analyses the data.

profiling.name: Profiling & anomalies
profiling.out: Missing values, duplicates and outliers detected.
profiling.real: {n} anomalous rows flagged by the profiler.
profiling.what: Measures each table (rows, duplicates, missing values, dates covered) and flags unusual rows with an Isolation Forest.

cleaning.name: Cleaning
cleaning.out: Versioned playbook applied: missing values filled, duplicates removed.
cleaning.what: Applies a versioned playbook: the same rules, in the same order, every time, each one logged.

etl.name: ETL & warehouse
etl.out: Warehouse built: one fact table and its dimensions.
etl.what: Builds the fact and dimension tables, with a receipt proving no join duplicated rows.

request.name: Question understanding
request.out: Business terms mapped to the KPI catalog.
request.what: Reads the question in plain words and maps it to a KPI, dimensions and periods of the catalog.

analysis.name: Analysis
analysis.what: Computes the KPI with SQL generated from the catalog, checks it four ways, then writes insights.

comparisons.name: Comparison check (BO4-12)
comparisons.blocked: Misleading as asked ({kinds}): a justified fix is proposed.
comparisons.what: Checks that the two periods can honestly be compared, and proposes a justified fix if not.

dashboard.name: Dashboard
dashboard.out: Charts drawn for the periods you validate.
dashboard.what: Chooses the charts and lays out the dashboard.

lineage.name: Lineage
lineage.what: Traces every KPI back to the source columns it is computed from.

auditor.name: Auditor & XAI
auditor.real: {n} anomalies explained with SHAP · journal {intact, select, ok {intact} other {BROKEN}} ({entries} entries) · drift: {drift}.
auditor.what: Explains the anomalies with SHAP, keeps the append-only journal, watches drift and answers “why?”.
